profile: The student wants to develop expertise in designing and training machine learning models using supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning approaches. They want to develop skills in code verification, refactoring, documenting software components, implementing change control, resolving operational problems, and fixing bugs. Additionally, the student intends to analyze user needs and apply computer science principles to create software solutions while embedding security throughout the development process.

They want to learn how to communicate findings effectively to stakeholders and provide actionable recommendations based on domain expertise.
